# PROVENANCE — data/raw/

`data/raw/` is **immutable**. Never write to it, never edit in place. Every
downstream file must be regenerable from `data/raw/` + `src/` + `configs/`.
(CLAUDE.md §7.4)

One row per downloaded file. Fill in at download time, not afterwards.

### CGGA

<!-- BEGIN AUTOGENERATED: CGGA -->
> **Transport: plain HTTP.** CGGA served one or more of these files over
> unencrypted HTTP. The SHA256 values below still bind each file to exactly
> the bytes we analysed, so the analysis is reproducible and any later
> alteration is detectable. They do **not** authenticate the source: an HTTP
> transfer cannot prove the bytes came from CGGA unmodified. These are
> different guarantees and only the first one is claimed here.

> **Expression matrix designation.** CGGA publishes two expression matrices per
> cohort: `Read_Counts` (2022-06-20) and `RSEM` (2020-05-06). Both are archived
> here. The **`Read_Counts` tables are the protocol matrix** for the replication
> test in CLAUDE.md §4.3; the RSEM tables are retained as a documented sensitivity
> option and are not used unless that use is declared. Decided 2026-08-23, before
> any replication result existed.
